# Copilot / AI agent instructions for Windows-Hinting

These instructions apply to all AI coding agents (GitHub Copilot chat, Copilot
coding agent, Cursor, Claude, etc.) working in this repository.

## Always build with full MSBuild, never `dotnet build`

This project references `UIAutomationClient` via a `<COMReference>` (tlbimp),
which the .NET Core version of MSBuild cannot resolve. Using `dotnet build`
fails with:

```
error MSB4803: The task "ResolveComReference" is not supported on the .NET Core
version of MSBuild. Please use the .NET Framework version of MSBuild.
```

Always build, restore, and publish this solution through the **full Visual
Studio MSBuild** (`MSBuild.exe` from a Developer PowerShell / Developer Command
Prompt, or the in-IDE build), not the `dotnet` CLI.

### Preferred build commands

When a tool or script needs to build from the command line, use one of these
(in order of preference):

1. **In-IDE build** — `run_build` tool, `Build > Build Solution`, or `Ctrl+Shift+B`.
2. **MSBuild from a Developer PowerShell:**

   ```pwsh
   MSBuild.exe .\Windows-Hinting.sln /t:Build /p:Configuration=Debug /restore
   ```

3. **`vswhere`-resolved MSBuild** (for CI or plain PowerShell):

   ```pwsh
   $vswhere = "${env:ProgramFiles(x86)}\Microsoft Visual Studio\Installer\vswhere.exe"
   $msbuild = & $vswhere -latest -prerelease -products * `
       -requires Microsoft.Component.MSBuild `
       -find MSBuild\**\Bin\MSBuild.exe | Select-Object -First 1
   & $msbuild .\Windows-Hinting.sln /t:Build /p:Configuration=Release /restore
   ```

### Do NOT use

- `dotnet build`
- `dotnet publish`
- `dotnet run`
- `dotnet test` against the main project

These will fail at `ResolveComReference`. The GitHub Actions workflow in
`.github/workflows/build.yml` already uses `setup-msbuild` / `MSBuild.exe` for
this reason — keep it that way.

## Other project conventions

- Target framework is `net10.0-windows`. Use the latest stable .NET 10 SDK; a
  preview SDK is not required.
- Nullability is enabled project-wide — keep new code null-safe.
- Native interop is generated by **CsWin32** from
  `Windows-Hinting/NativeMethods.txt`. When you need a new Win32 API, add it to
  that file and use `Windows.Win32.PInvoke.*` — do not add hand-written
  `[DllImport]` declarations.
- UI Automation stays on the existing `UIAutomationClient` COM tlbimp reference
  (this is the reason MSBuild is required). Do not try to regenerate UIA via
  CsWin32.
- Per-monitor DPI is `PerMonitorV2` (manifest + csproj); overlays are one
  WinForms form per `Screen`. Do not introduce a single spanning overlay HWND.
- Verification is manual — there are no automated tests. After changes, rebuild
  in VS and confirm: hotkeys fire, hints render on primary + secondary monitors,
  mouse clicks route correctly, and display-change rebuilds overlays.
